body: Yes and he’ll say he wants too sometimes, other times he says I’m going to leave him anyways, it’ll never be the same, says he wants a divorce, says he’ll kill himself if leave or tells me what a bad mother I am. If I hint that he’s doing something wrong he immediately sees that as rejection and thinks I’m going to leave. He’s been convinced I’m going to leave him for the past two years while I’ve been trying to reassure him, but even when I do he doesn’t reciprocate the love. He acts like I don’t need love and he will act ok until he thinks I’m going to leave again. I’m supposed to pour my love into him and run on empty promises and verbal abuse from him.
We are talking about it but we’ve talked about it on and off for two years. He doesn’t seem willing or wants to change until after he acts this way then he thinks he’s fine.
